# ionic-logging-viewer

> Viewer component for logs written by ionic-logging-service

> Generated by compodoc 2.0.0 at 2026-07-15T13:48:04.978Z, llm-md export.

## Components

### LoggingViewerComponent

File: `src/lib/logging-viewer/logging-viewer.component.ts`
Selector: `ionic-logging-viewer`

Description: Component for displaying the current logs. The component can be embedded in any web page using: \<ionic-logging-viewer\>\</ionic-logging-viewer\>

Inputs:
- `localStorageKeys: string | undefined = undefined` — Comma-separated list of localStorageKeys. If set, the logs get loaded from localStorage instead of memory.

Properties:
- `logMessagesForDisplay: unknown = signal<LogMessage[]>([])` — Log messages which fulfill the filter condition.

Methods:
- `filterLogMessages(logMessages: LogMessage[], level: string, search: string): void` — Filter the log messages.
- `filterLogMessagesByLevel(message: LogMessage, level: string): boolean` — Check if the log message's level fulfills the level condition.
- `filterLogMessagesBySearch(message: LogMessage, search: string): boolean` — Check if the log message fulfills the search condition. The search value gets searched in: logger name method name message

### LoggingViewerLevelsComponent

File: `src/lib/logging-viewer-levels/logging-viewer-levels.component.ts`
Selector: `ionic-logging-viewer-levels`

Description: Component for displaying the log levels for filtering the current logs. The component can be embedded in any web page using: \<ionic-logging-viewer-levels\>\</ionic-logging-viewer-levels\>

Properties:
- `logLevels: string[]` — Log levels used for filtering: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR
- `selectedLevel: string = ""` — Selected level.

Methods:
- `onLevelChanged(): void` — Callback when the level was changed in the UI.

### LoggingViewerModalComponent

File: `src/lib/logging-viewer-modal/logging-viewer-modal.component.ts`
Selector: `ionic-logging-viewer-modal`

Description: Ionic modal containing LoggingViewerComponent , LoggingViewerLevelsComponent and LoggingViewerSearchComponent .

Inputs:
- `allowClearLogs: boolean = true` — Flag showing a delete button, which removes all existing log messages.
- `language: string | undefined = undefined` — Language to be used for the modal. Currently supported: en, de
- `localStorageKeys: string | undefined = undefined` — Comma-separated list of localStorageKeys. If set, the logs get loaded from localStorage instead of memory.
- `translation: LoggingViewerTranslation | undefined = undefined` — Translation to be used for the modal. If specified, the language is ignored.

Properties:
- `isAndroid: boolean` — Flag controlling which close button will be shown.

Methods:
- `clearLogs(): void` — Clear logs.
- `getTranslation(): LoggingViewerTranslation` — Helper method returning the current translation: the property translation if defined the translation according property language if valid English translation, otherwise
- `ionViewDidEnter(): void` — Eventhandler called by Ionic when the modal is opened.
- `ngOnInit(): void` — Initializes the LoggingViewerModalComponent. It configures the supported translations.
- `onClearLogs(): Promise<void>` — Eventhandler called when the clear button is clicked.
- `onClose(): Promise<void>` — Eventhandler called when the cancel button is clicked.

### LoggingViewerSearchComponent

File: `src/lib/logging-viewer-search/logging-viewer-search.component.ts`
Selector: `ionic-logging-viewer-search`

Description: Component for displaying the search bar for filtering the current logs. The component can be embedded in any web page using: \<ionic-logging-viewer-search placeholder="Search"\>\</ionic-logging-viewer-search\>

Inputs:
- `placeholder: string | undefined = undefined` — Placeholder to be shown in the empty search bar.

Properties:
- `search: string = ""` — Current search value.

Methods:
- `onSearchChanged(): void` — Callback when the search value was changed in the UI.

## Services / Injectables

### LoggingViewerFilterService

File: `src/lib/logging-viewer-filter.service.ts`
providedIn: `root`

Description: Service for storing filter settings for logging viewer.

Properties:
- `level: unknown = signal("DEBUG")` — Signal for the current log level.
- `search: unknown = signal("")` — Signal for the current search value.

## Interfaces

### LoggingViewerModalProperties

File: `src/lib/logging-viewer-modal/logging-viewer-modal-properties.model.ts`

Description: Describes all properties which can be passed to the LoggingViewerModalComponent .

Properties:
- `allowClearLogs?: boolean` — Flag showing a delete button, which removes all existing log messages.
- `language?: string` — Language to be used for the modal. Currently supported: en, de
- `localStorageKeys?: string` — Comma-separated list of localStorageKeys. If set, the logs get loaded from localStorage instead of memory.
- `translation?: LoggingViewerTranslation` — Translation to be used for the modal. If specified, the language is ignored.

### LoggingViewerTranslation

File: `src/lib/logging-viewer-translation.model.ts`

Description: Describes all values needed in a translation for LoggingViewerModalComponent .

Properties:
- `cancel: string` — Cancel button. There are two cancel buttons: in the modal itself (iOS only) and the confirmation for deleting the messages.
- `confirmDelete: string` — Confirmation message for deleting log messages.
- `ok: string` — Ok button.
- `searchPlaceholder: string` — Placeholder for search bar.
- `title: string` — Title of the modal.
